item.text: `ModalTwo` renders a native `<dialog>` without an `open` attribute, which explains why role queries can miss its contents. I’ll move the host element into `Dialog`, set `open` from `ModalTwo`, and use a role-bearing fallback where native dialog methods are unavailable.

The wrapper and regression tests are in place. The tests check role lookup inside `ModalTwo` and ref, attribute, and child forwarding through `Dialog`. I’m running the component tests and TypeScript check now.

item.text:
Added a public [Dialog component](/app/packages/components/components/dialog/Dialog.tsx) that forwards attributes, children, and its host ref. It uses a native `<dialog>` when supported and an accessible fallback in limited DOM environments. [ModalTwo](/app/packages/components/components/modalTwo/Modal.tsx) now uses it with `open`, so interactive children are discoverable by role in JSDOM.

Verification passed: 11 relevant tests, TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier.
